deliverables: Upgrade Cardano mainnet protocol to major version 11 and minor version 0 while remaining in the Conway era.
Make new Plutus primitives from CIP-0109, CIP-0132, CIP-0133, CIP-0138, and CIP-0153 available.
Make all Plutus built-in functions available consistently across Plutus V1, V2, and V3.
Support case expressions for built-in Bool, Integer, and Data in Untyped Plutus Core.

Promote or tighten several ledger and node validation rules, including VRF key hash uniqueness, reference input rules, Constitutional Committee voting restriction handling, withdrawal validation, and PPView mismatch reporting.
request.what: Initiate an intra-era hard fork of Cardano Mainnet to Protocol Version 11.0, named the van Rossem hard fork.

claims.claim: The proposal would upgrade Cardano Mainnet from protocol version 10.0 to protocol version 11.0 through an intra-era hard fork while remaining in the Conway era.
The proposer states that transaction shape does not change and ecosystem upgrade effort is minimized because the hard fork is intra-era.

The upgrade introduces new Plutus primitives defined by CIP-0109, CIP-0132, CIP-0133, CIP-0138, and CIP-0153, covering modular exponentiation, dropList, BLS12-381 multi-scalar multiplication, Array, and Value functionality.
The proposer states that all Plutus built-in functions will become available across Plutus V1, V2, and V3, expanding capabilities for existing V1 and V2 scripts.
The proposer states that native case expressions over Bool, Integer, and Data in UPLC will improve performance and produce cleaner script logic.

The proposal claims testing reports show no behavioral regressions, complete specification-to-implementation conformance for new ledger rules, and correct operation of new Plutus primitives and case expressions across Plutus V1, V2, and V3.

The proposal cites a Cardano Node 11.0.1 performance report as showing no regressions for standard value, Plutus, and voting benchmarks and acceptable baseline performance for new Plutus primitives and case expressions.
The proposal states security audits have been undertaken for Plutus BLS primitives and execution costs for all Plutus primitives.

The proposal states at least 85% of stake pools by active stake should have upgraded to a node version capable of protocol version 11 before ratification, and that this condition must be verified by the Constitutional Committee and SPOs with support from Intersect readiness reports.

The proposal states reversion is only possible in extreme circumstances through the CIP-0135 disaster recovery process, while Plutus primitive use could be disabled by changing companion cost model settings if issues are found.

summary: The document requests a no-treasury hard fork initiation to Cardano protocol version 11.0, presenting Plutus, ledger, and node changes with cited CIPs and a performance report, but several safety and readiness claims are asserted rather than evidenced directly in the anchor text.
